summary.text: AUSCH scored 209-5 with top scorer D Arcy Short making 66 off 25 balls, while Hardus Viljoen took 3 for 29. SACH replied with 213-2, led by top scorer and captain AB de Villiers with 114 off 40 balls, as Kane Richardson claimed 2 for 26. South Africa Champions won by 8 wkts.
